Name: Game Modes
Description:
A game mode picker on the New Game screens, for mods that add ways to play.

On its own it changes nothing: with no mod adding a mode, New Game is the game's own. Mods like [url=https://github.com/FezVrasta/BeaverBuddies-CoOp-PvP-Edition]BeaverBuddies Co-Op/PvP Edition[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3814012422]Timber Empires[/url] add theirs, and each mode comes with its own line about what it plays like.

[h2]For mod authors[/h2]
Add a mode with GameModes.Modes.Add(id, labelLocKey), describe it with Describe, and read the pick as the game loads with Modes.Game. Source and details: [url=https://github.com/FezVrasta/timberborn-game-modes]github.com/FezVrasta/timberborn-game-modes[/url].
